name: Kouen Ojisan no Ichigo Gari
original_name: 公園おじさんのいちご狩り
source:
A man gently watching over the girls playing in the park...
With no one else to play with, the girls had completely let their guard down around him!
With their parents coming home late, the girls were eventually invited to the man’s house...
And once a month, a “kindergarten festival” is held at the man’s house... The girls’ supple bodies are met with the dark, leering stares of the male customers who paid high admission fees!!

[Machine translated]
translation:
一名大叔正温柔地守望着在公园里玩耍的小女孩们……
由于没有其他玩伴，女孩们早已对他彻底放下了戒心！
趁着她们的父母下班晚归，女孩们最终被大叔邀请到了家中……
而在大叔家里，每个月都会举办一次“幼稚园庆典”……女孩们娇嫩柔韧的身躯，迎来了支付高昂入场费的男客人们阴暗而贪婪的下流目光！！

[译自日文简介]
